description: Finnair Plus Avios and tier points for a Finnair ticket. Both = (fare in EUR: the base fare plus any airline surcharge for the whole ticket, without taxes; plus travel extras on Finnair flights) x tier factor (Basic 6, Silver 7, Gold 8, Platinum 9, Platinum Lumo 10), rounded down. Set flt to CS for a Finnair codeshare flight (AY2501-AY7000) booked from 3 June 2025, where extras earn nothing. Progress toward Silver (15,000), Gold (45,000), Platinum (80,000) and Platinum Lumo (300,000) tier points; tp is the tier points so far. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Give the price in EUR, not US dollars. Unofficial.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Finnair's own: american = American AAdvantage (creditStatus one of: AAdvantage member, AAdvantage Gold, AAdvantage Platinum, AAdvantage Platinum Pro, AAdvantage Executive Platinum); alaska = Atmos Rewards (creditStatus one of: Atmos Rewards member, Atmos Silver, Atmos Gold, Atmos Platinum, Atmos Titanium); ba-club = British Airways Club (creditStatus one of: Blue, Bronze, Silver, Gold). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

extras.description: Travel extras (EUR, optional). The total price of travel extras bought for Finnair flights (for example bags or seats). They earn at the same rate as the fare. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

flt.description: Flight. AY = Finnair flight (AY0001-AY2000, AY7001-AY7500); CS = Codeshare flight (AY2501-AY7000, booked from 3 June 2025). The flight number on your ticket. Codeshare flights booked before 3 June 2025 earn by distance and are not covered here.

price.description: Fare paid (EUR, whole ticket) in EUR. In euros: the base fare plus any airline surcharge ("Extra fee" in the price breakdown) for the whole ticket, without taxes and airport charges. Finnair converts a fare paid in another currency to euros itself. Required unless creditTo is given.

status.description: Your Finnair Plus tier when you fly. BS = Basic (6 per €1); SV = Silver (7 per €1); GD = Gold (8 per €1); PT = Platinum (9 per €1); LU = Platinum Lumo (10 per €1).

tp.description: Tier points you have so far (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next tier.
